(1) GR6 d) 3 a) / c) — THE 31-CHARACTER SIZE RULE, which was absent entirely. CobolNum.FromAlphanumeric now takes the rightmost 31 CHARACTER POSITIONS of the sending operand before the digit scan (the window is over positions, not digit characters: §14.6.13.2 lets a non-digit position contribute no digit while still occupying a position). MOVE A40 TO PIC 9(9) stores 234567890 where it stored the Int128 wrap 838277934; into PIC 9(31) it stores 0123456789012345678901234567890 where it stored 7560297064841152750825838277934; the 40-character LITERAL form (sub-rule c) agrees. With the cap in place 31 digits < 10^31 < Int128.MaxValue, so the carrier the old decode reached is unreachable by construction. The other five channels that shared the decode (reference modification, the group image, UNSTRING INTO, the numeric-edited arm, the current-record read) were repaired by the same change, at the ONE decode.

(2) GR6 d) 1's closing sentence — EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE, which was raised for no sender kind. The new CobolNum.FromAlphanumericSending is the twin of ParseImageSending (§14.6.13.2 rule 2): it delegates the predicate to the ONE class-condition implementation CobolClass.IsNumeric (§8.8.4.4.4 GR3 n) 2) and is emitted only where GR6 d) applies, through the new SendingRef.MoveToNumeric context and the new SendingRefRules.AlphanumericChecked reading. BOTH probes this row's prior note recorded as diverging now raise a fatal EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE under >>TURN EC-ALL CHECKING ON, re-run on this tree: the alphanumeric sender (PIC X(3) "A1B" -> PIC 9(3)) through the new GR6 d) 1 arm, and the numeric-DISPLAY REDEFINES sender through §14.6.13.2 rule 2's arm (kb/Work PB230's, already landed). With checking OFF the tolerant deterministic decode stands, which is conformant because the standard makes the result undefined here.

(3) The prior note's two UNVERIFIED EDGES are settled. GR6 b) 1 (the same alphanumeric-edited or national-edited item as both operands) is expressly "undefined" by the standard and so cannot diverge. GR6 c)'s endianness-only sentence IS now exercised: FLOAT-BINARY-64 HIGH-ORDER-LEFT <-> HIGH-ORDER-RIGHT round-trips 1.0E+300 in both directions with no change to the value (probe PB426/probe/p11_endian).
